description: This PHP class EmployeeReportingMethodService provides methods for managing employee reporting relationships, such as retrieving supervisors and subordinates, and handling associated data through a DAO. It also includes utility methods for managing lists of employee IDs.

classes.name: EmployeeReportingMethodService
classes.description: Service class for handling employee reporting relationships such as fetching supervisors and subordinates, managing DAO instance, and providing utility methods for ID list management.

methods.name: getEmployeeReportingMethodDao
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the EmployeeReportingMethodDao instance.

methods.name: setEmployeeReportingMethodDao
methods.description: Sets the EmployeeReportingMethodDao instance, allowing dependency injection.

methods.name: getImmediateSupervisorListForEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves a list of immediate supervisors for an employee based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: getImmediateSupervisorListCountForEmployee
methods.description: Counts the number of immediate supervisors for an employee.

methods.name: getSubordinateListForEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves a list of subordinates for an employee.

methods.name: getSubordinateListCountForEmployee
methods.description: Counts the number of subordinates for an employee.

methods.name: getAccessibleAndAvailableSupervisorsIdCombinedList
methods.description: Returns the list of accessible supervisor IDs excluding those already assigned.

methods.name: getAlreadyAssignedSupervisorsSubordinatesAndSelfIdCombinedList
methods.description: Merges lists of supervisors, subordinates, and includes the employee's own ID.
